paragraphs.note: Sentence 0 treats the Jinni in Xiphos' Moonlight as a Jinni whose name is known. The material only lists that Jinni as known and gives no personal name (most Jinn are unnamed). The Aryadeva title clause is supported. Sentence 1 matches the cited lines.
paragraphs.quote: Hey, look at that. Isn't there something shiny under that big tree? Could that be the Jinni we're looking for?
